concerns.text: Task T021 (DBSCAN aggregation) is marked [P] but depends on T017 (US1 output: precursor_metrics.csv). T021 cannot run in parallel with T013-T017 as it consumes their artifact. The [P] tag is incorrect; T021 must be ordered after T017.
Task T022 (Permutation Test) is marked [P] but depends on T021 (shear band aggregation). T022 cannot run in parallel with T021. The [P] tag is incorrect; T022 must be ordered after T021.

Task T028a (Derive base threshold) is marked [US3] but implicitly depends on US1 and US2 outputs (precursor_metrics.csv and statistical results). It is listed before T021/T022 in the task list, violating the producer-consumer flow. T028a must be ordered after T025.

Task T035 (Execute full pipeline) is marked [P] but depends on T032a/T033a (metrics instrumentation) AND the completion of US1/US2/US3 implementation. It cannot run in parallel with the implementation tasks it measures. The [P] tag is incorrect; T035 must be ordered after all implementation tasks.

Task T032b/T033b (limit checks) depend on T035 output. The text notes this, but the [P] tag on T032b/T033b implies they can run in parallel with T035 or each other without ordering. They must be strictly ordered after T035.

Phase 7 tasks (T036-T040) are marked [P] and placed after US1 implementation. However, T036 (error handling) and T038 (NaN checks) are integral to the implementation of T013-T016 (preprocess.py). Placing them as a separate parallel phase after the core logic implies the core logic is written without these checks first, violating the 'producer before consumer' of robust code. These should be integrated into T013-T016 or ordered immediately after T016 but before T017 (output generation).
